newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Malaysia gets $26.3 mln loan to clean Klang river.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia gets $26.3 mln loan to clean Klang river.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) said on Thursday it had approved a $26.3 million loan to partly help clean up the Klang river basin in Malaysia.
The 120-km river is slowly being polluted by rapid urbanisation and industrialisation along the river bank, it said.

"The project will coordinate the work of other agencies in managing the river basin and will use an integrated approach to tackle the main problems of soil erosion, river sedimentation and pollution, the loss of areas of ecological value, and perennial flooding," the Manila-based bank said in a statement.
The loan, from the bank's ordinary capital resources, has an interest rate of 6.82 percent adjustable every six months.
The repayment period spans 15 years including a six-year grace period.
